snippet.title: End Them, Soldier! - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2879200/End_Them_Soldier/

First gameplay trailer for End Them, Soldier! 
Destroy, annihilate your enemies. Nothing will stop you on your path of vengeance.

End Them, Soldier! – A blisteringly fast-paced old-school shooter.
You’ll carve through hordes of enemies standing between you and vengeance.
Play as a nameless soldier in the near future - a disciple of Caleb - and bear the weight of the chaos you’ve unleashed upon the world.

Coming 2025 in Steam.
